Our team of certified technicians takes pride in both the quality of our work and in offering you peace of mind, guaranteeing their work and your experience. First, as a member of the NAPA Auto Care Center network, we offer a 24-month/24,000-mile nationwide warranty on our repairs. Second, all of our employees operate using the shop’s Code of Ethics. Highlights of this promise to you are to honor and value you as a customer, provide superior quality services at fair prices, make reliable recommendations, offer timely maintenance and repair, and effectively communicate about services and completion times. Additionally, we actively work to make your trip to the shop for auto maintenance and repair as convenient and efficient as possible. From the ease of making an appointment with a friendly service adviser to buying gas where you get your car repaired to getting all maintenance and repairs in a single location, you’ll save time, money, and hassle when you entrust your vehicle to Chet’s Courtesy Automotive. | Prepared to Serve You | You can feel confident that the staff of Chet’s Courtesy Automotive is well qualified to take care of all your vehicle’s maintenance and repair needs. As a new business, Chet’s Courtesy Automotive won the 2006 AC Delco Valued Member of the Total Service and Support Program award. Thus, you can be assured that our staff knows how to care for you and your ca. We are able to perform routine maintenance services, a full range of repairs, and minor bodywork on any make or model car or 4×4. We also specialize in classic car restoration, loving your rolling piece of history as much as you do. | Total Customer Service | Chet’s Courtesy Automotive offers driver’s in the Naples, Florida, area a total quality customer service experience. While we work on any make and model , we love being entrusted with your classic car, even offering restorations. Community matters to us, as well. We donate to the Naples Pelican Bay Rotary Club to assist them in their mission of humanitarian service and participate in their annual Chalk Art on Fifth event.
